carrier_note: Draft JSON carrier. Final adoption per FIRE_SMOKE_DESIGN.md SS8 requires re-encoding as RISE-CBOR64-v1; adopted record ID is SHA-256 of those exact CBOR bytes.
closure_paths: owner library pulls (Samaniego 1995; Markstein 1985 series; Koseki & Yumoto 1988; SFPE Ch.36; Thomsen 2017) - may supply same-regime evidence
RESOLVED: computed bounds qualify in principle (see owner_ruling_2026_08_05); the construction must meet the revised derived-record uncertainty requirements
lab measurement required only where model discrepancy cannot be bounded from same-regime data
criterion: SS7.0: 95%-confidence upper bound on chemiluminescent power below BOTH (i) 1% of the fuel/case's measured 380-780nm radiant power AND (ii) the absolute radiance gate's uncertainty at every gated wavelength

HRR_W.source: Hamins, Bundy & Dillon 2005, J.Fire Prot.Eng. 15:265-285 p.277 (open, read)

denominator_inputs.no_direct_measurement: no published 380-780nm band radiometry of a candle found

route1_luminous.basis: 1 cd convention (12.6 lm) / computed soot-spectrum visible luminous efficacy 103-131 lm/W_vis at 1900-2200K

route2_radiative.basis: chi_r*HRR x soot-weighted visible fraction at Teff 1600-2000K

leg_ii_blocker: Leg (ii) is un-evaluable until SS12 item 4 (absolute radiance-gate dataset) closes: no gated wavelengths or gate uncertainty exist yet. Structural dependency, independent of leg (i).
notes: blue base visibly distinct in dim light - consistent with percent-level, not proof of sub-percent
the two denominator routes disagree ~5x because a flame is not isothermal and chi_r includes IR gas bands

classic_1e-4.source: Samaniego, Egolfopoulos & Bowman 1995, Combust. Sci. Technol. 109:183-203 (owner library pull)

diffusion_flame_specific.note: No published measurement of total visible chem power for diffusion flames. Computable route: Slack & Grillo 1985 CO2* kinetics (via Nori & Seitzman AIAA 2008-953 Eq.3) + Jin et al. 2020 ACS Omega 5:15922 calibrated CH*/OH* fields (figures only)

open_upper_bound.source: Samaniego, CTR Annual Research Briefs 1994, Table 2 p.31 (open, read)

owner_ruling_2026_08_05: OWNER RULING 2026-08-05 - policy closed, record stays preview: computed bounds QUALIFY IN PRINCIPLE under revised SS7.0 language ('a pinned evidence record reports a one-sided 95%-confidence upper bound, obtained either directly or through a validated measurement model over traceable measured inputs; a derived record must include measurement, covariance, digitization, geometry, spectral-truncation, domain-transfer, and model-form uncertainties' - design-loop edit pending), but the present Slack-Grillo + Jin + Hamins construction FAILS it: kinetics model is not a same-case measurement; methane-field transfer to this fuel is an unbounded domain-transfer discrepancy; numerator channel completeness undemonstrated; chi_r x soot-T is not a measured visible denominator (~5x reconstruction spread); leg (ii) untestable until Q4 freezes. Lab work not required by definition; required for any fuel whose model discrepancy cannot be bounded from same-regime data.
verdict: INDETERMINATE at the 1% threshold: defensible open-literature bound fails by ~2 orders; plausible unverified estimates straddle 1%. Not a 95%-confidence record in either direction.
